name: Carry Quartile Predictive Test — ZC & ZS
description: Filters corn (ZC) and soybean (ZS) futures to days where carry exceeds 5% (strong backwardation). Buckets those observations into quartiles using expanding historical quantile thresholds (no look-ahead bias). For each quartile, shows average 63-day forward carry and hit rate (% of times forward carry is positive). Uses carry << 63 lead operator (not forward_returns) to avoid division-by-zero at carry crossings. ZC is the primary asset; ZS is loaded via reference_futures + futures_continuation with NoAdjustment.
source:
# =============================================================================
# CARRY QUARTILE PREDICTIVE TEST — ZC (primary) & ZS (reference)
# =============================================================================
#
# METHODOLOGY:
#   1. Filter to days where carry > 5% (strong backwardation only)
#   2. Compute expanding Q25/Q50/Q75 thresholds on filtered carry
#      → no look-ahead bias: thresholds use only history up to each date
#   3. Assign quartile label 1-4 via conditional_select
#   4. Forward carry = carry << 63 (lead operator, NOT forward_returns)
#      → forward_returns on carry → inf when carry crosses zero (S46)
#   5. Hit rate = ternary 1/0 (S41), guarded with is_valid (S02)
#
# ASSETS:
#   ZC — primary via market_data_source + futures_continuation
#   ZS — reference via reference_futures + futures_continuation
#
# ADJUSTMENT: NoAdjustment for both
#   → carry = M1/M2 - 1 is a level signal; price adjustment irrelevant
#   → consistent with template pattern for term structure signals
# =============================================================================

# --- ZC: Primary asset (Corn) ---
src = market_data_source()()
zc_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

zc_carry = zc_cont.carry

# --- ZS: Reference asset (Soybeans) ---
zs_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZS')()
zs_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zs_raw.o, zs_raw.h, zs_raw.l, zs_raw.c, zs_raw.v, zs_raw.oi, zs_raw.s)

zs_carry = zs_cont.carry

# =============================================================================
# ZC CARRY QUARTILE ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

# --- Filter: only days where ZC carry > 5% ---
zc_carry_filtered = where(zc_carry > 0.05, zc_carry)

# --- Expanding quantile thresholds on filtered carry (no look-ahead) ---
# cumulative(Quantile) drops NaN inputs → only filtered (>5%) observations
# contribute to the expanding distribution
zc_q25 = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Quantile, q=0.25)(zc_carry_filtered))
zc_q50 = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Quantile, q=0.50)(zc_carry_filtered))
zc_q75 = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Quantile, q=0.75)(zc_carry_filtered))

# --- Assign quartile label 1-4 (only on filtered days) ---
# Q1 = lowest carry (just above 5%), Q4 = highest carry
zc_quartile_raw = conditional_select(
    is_valid(zc_q25) and zc_carry > 0.05 and zc_carry <= zc_q25, 1.0,
    is_valid(zc_q50) and zc_carry > 0.05 and zc_carry > zc_q25 and zc_carry <= zc_q50, 2.0,
    is_valid(zc_q75) and zc_carry > 0.05 and zc_carry > zc_q50 and zc_carry <= zc_q75, 3.0,
    is_valid(zc_q75) and zc_carry > 0.05 and zc_carry > zc_q75, 4.0,
    0.0
)
# Replace 0.0 (unfiltered days) with NaN so reporters skip them
zc_quartile = where(zc_quartile_raw > 0, zc_quartile_raw)

# --- Forward carry: carry level 63 bars ahead (S46: use << not forward_returns) ---
zc_fwd_carry = zc_carry << 63

# --- Avg forward carry per quartile (only on filtered days with valid fwd) ---
zc_fwd_carry_filtered = where(is_valid(zc_quartile) and is_valid(zc_fwd_carry), zc_fwd_carry)

# --- Hit rate: 1 if forward carry is positive, 0 otherwise (S41 + S02) ---
zc_hit = 1.0 if (is_valid(zc_fwd_carry) and is_valid(zc_quartile) and zc_fwd_carry > 0) else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# ZS CARRY QUARTILE ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

# --- Filter: only days where ZS carry > 5% ---
zs_carry_filtered = where(zs_carry > 0.05, zs_carry)

# --- Expanding quantile thresholds on filtered carry ---
zs_q25 = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Quantile, q=0.25)(zs_carry_filtered))
zs_q50 = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Quantile, q=0.50)(zs_carry_filtered))
zs_q75 = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Quantile, q=0.75)(zs_carry_filtered))

# --- Assign quartile label 1-4 (only on filtered days) ---
zs_quartile_raw = conditional_select(
    is_valid(zs_q25) and zs_carry > 0.05 and zs_carry <= zs_q25, 1.0,
    is_valid(zs_q50) and zs_carry > 0.05 and zs_carry > zs_q25 and zs_carry <= zs_q50, 2.0,
    is_valid(zs_q75) and zs_carry > 0.05 and zs_carry > zs_q50 and zs_carry <= zs_q75, 3.0,
    is_valid(zs_q75) and zs_carry > 0.05 and zs_carry > zs_q75, 4.0,
    0.0
)
zs_quartile = where(zs_quartile_raw > 0, zs_quartile_raw)

# --- Forward carry: carry level 63 bars ahead ---
zs_fwd_carry = zs_carry << 63

# --- Avg forward carry per quartile ---
zs_fwd_carry_filtered = where(is_valid(zs_quartile) and is_valid(zs_fwd_carry), zs_fwd_carry)

# --- Hit rate: 1 if forward carry is positive, 0 otherwise ---
zs_hit = 1.0 if (is_valid(zs_fwd_carry) and is_valid(zs_quartile) and zs_fwd_carry > 0) else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1: Avg 63-Day Forward Carry by Quartile — ZC & ZS
# Grouped bars: Q1-Q4 on x-axis, ZC vs ZS side-by-side
# =============================================================================
xy_bars(
    title='Does Higher Carry Predict Higher Forward Carry? (63-Day)',
    category='Carry Quartile Test',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    x_axis_label='Carry Quartile (Q1=Lowest, Q4=Highest)',
    y_axis_label='Avg 63-Day Forward Carry',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='ZC Corn', color=Color.Blue, stack='ZC'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='ZS Soybeans', color=Color.Amber, stack='ZS')
    ]),
    order=1
)(values=(zc_fwd_carry_filtered, zs_fwd_carry_filtered), label=(zc_quartile, zs_quartile))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2: Hit Rate by Quartile — ZC & ZS
# % of times 63-day forward carry is positive, by quartile bucket
# =============================================================================
xy_bars(
    title='How Often Is Forward Carry Positive? Hit Rate by Quartile',
    category='Carry Quartile Test',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    x_axis_label='Carry Quartile (Q1=Lowest, Q4=Highest)',
    y_axis_label='Hit Rate (% Positive Fwd Carry)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    data_labels=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='50% (Coin Flip)')
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='ZC Corn', color=Color.Blue, stack='ZC'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='ZS Soybeans', color=Color.Amber, stack='ZS')
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=(zc_hit, zs_hit), label=(zc_quartile, zs_quartile))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 3: Summary Table — ZC Quartile Stats
# N observations, avg current carry, avg fwd carry, hit rate per quartile
# =============================================================================
# Observation count per quartile (ternary → 1 on filtered days, 0 otherwise)
zc_obs = 1.0 if is_valid(zc_quartile) else 0.0
zs_obs = 1.0 if is_valid(zs_quartile) else 0.0

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Carry Quartile Stats: ZC Corn (Carry > 5%, 63-Day Forward)',
        row_size=4,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['Q1 (Lowest)', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4 (Highest)'],
        col_headers=['Obs Days', 'Avg Carry', 'Avg Fwd Carry', 'Hit Rate'],
        cells=[
            # Q1 row
            ColumnSpec(info='Q1: Observation count', grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(info='Q1: Avg current carry', grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='Q1: Avg 63d fwd carry', grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='Q1: Hit rate (fwd carry > 0)', grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            # Q2 row
            ColumnSpec(info='Q2: Observation count', grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(info='Q2: Avg current carry', grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='Q2: Avg 63d fwd carry', grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='Q2: Hit rate (fwd carry > 0)', grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            # Q3 row
            ColumnSpec(info='Q3: Observation count', grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(info='Q3: Avg current carry', grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='Q3: Avg 63d fwd carry', grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='Q3: Hit rate (fwd carry > 0)', grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            # Q4 row
            ColumnSpec(info='Q4: Observation count', grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(info='Q4: Avg current carry', grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='Q4: Avg 63d fwd carry', grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='Q4: Hit rate (fwd carry > 0)', grid_row=3, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='Carry Quartile Test',
    order=0
)(
    where(zc_quartile == 1.0, zc_obs), where(zc_quartile == 1.0, zc_carry),
    where(zc_quartile == 1.0, zc_fwd_carry), where(zc_quartile == 1.0, zc_hit),
    where(zc_quartile == 2.0, zc_obs), where(zc_quartile == 2.0, zc_carry),
    where(zc_quartile == 2.0, zc_fwd_carry), where(zc_quartile == 2.0, zc_hit),
    where(zc_quartile == 3.0, zc_obs), where(zc_quartile == 3.0, zc_carry),
    where(zc_quartile == 3.0, zc_fwd_carry), where(zc_quartile == 3.0, zc_hit),
    where(zc_quartile == 4.0, zc_obs), where(zc_quartile == 4.0, zc_carry),
    where(zc_quartile == 4.0, zc_fwd_carry), where(zc_quartile == 4.0, zc_hit)
)
